notablePrerequisites:
Sword of the Paruns attached to Kiki-Jiki.
There are at least four colors among permanents you control.
description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Bloom Tender with haste.
Activate the Bloom Tender token by tapping it, adding at least {2}{R}{G}.
Activate Sword of the Paruns by paying {3}, untapping Kiki-Jiki.
Repeat.
